sloka: चतुर्भ्यो ऽपि समुद्रेभ्यः सन्ध्यामन्वास्य रावण ।इमं मुहूर्तमायाति वाली तिष्ठ मुहूर्तकम् ।। ७.३४.६ ॥
transliteration: caturbhyo 'pi samudrebhyaḥ sandhyāmanvāsya rāvaṇa ।imaṁ muhūrtamāyāti vālī tiṣṭha muhūrtakam ।। 7.34.6 ॥

translations.english: O Ravana, Vali is returning in a moment, having performed his twilight prayers from all four oceans; wait for just a moment.
